eps.t: The Mask of the War God
eps.ov: Peru desperately defends himself against the terrifying might of the Mask of the War God.
Peru and Sona meet a strange chain smoking man in the town of Cornwall.
Peru and his companions visit the Strega Museum, where several people are rumored to have gone missing.
Peru and his companions devise a plan to free Tina.
Peru returns to his hometown just in time for the festival celebrating Gaston's birthday.
Peru meets a strange man dressed in black in his dreams.
